ml_match.prompt_snippet:
Opus 5.5 on the Trading House

❯ Using React/TypeScript (Remotion), every image drawn in SVG and Canvas, an open-source TTS voice, and a score synthesized in Python. No stock footage. No image generators.

❯ Build a short 30-60s animation work about the Trading House

scenes.voiceover: Direct market access, designed for the modern trader.
scenes.veo_prompt: Abstract digital aesthetic showing clean geometric lines converging into a financial data stream, dark mode background.

scenes.voiceover: Execute orders instantly with the Kite interface, built for speed and clarity.
scenes.veo_prompt: High-fidelity screen capture of the Zerodha Kite trading dashboard, clean UI, showing market depth and order placement.

scenes.voiceover: See your trades in action with real-time data streaming directly to your dashboard.
scenes.veo_prompt: Top-down cinematic shot of a clean, modern workspace with a laptop displaying a trading chart, minimalist lighting.

scenes.voiceover: Experience the platform. Visit zerodha.com to get started.
scenes.veo_prompt: Professional outro screen with the Zerodha logo centered on a dark background, elegant motion, clear call to action.
